title: CatalogStatus
description: Health and funnel telemetry for the ingest + screening pipeline.

object_count.description: Number of objects in the current catalogue snapshot.

last_refresh.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent successful catalogue ingest.

next_refresh.description: UTC timestamp of the next scheduled ingest (6-hourly by default).

source.description: Identifier of the upstream data source, e.g. celestrak-gp-active.

epoch_age_hours.description: Distribution of TLE epoch age across the current catalogue, hours.

screening_window_hours.description: Forward propagation horizon used by the last screening run, hours. 72 by default.

last_screen_duration_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the last full screening run, seconds.

pairs_considered.description: Total object pairs entering the coarse filter, ~N(N-1)/2 for N objects.

pairs_fine_screened.description: Pairs surviving the coarse filter and re-propagated at 1-second resolution. Must be >99.99% smaller than pairs_considered.

events_found.description: Conjunction events emitted by the last screening run.
